title: XrayAttenuation.jl: NIST XCOM photon attenuation coefficients with K-edge aware interpolation
description: Julia package providing X-ray photon attenuation coefficients from the NIST XCOM database for all 92 elements, a curated catalog of 100+ predefined materials (tissues, bones, polymers, detectors, contrast agents, Gammex 472 CT calibration inserts), and compound / mixture composition by chemical formula or mass fraction. Uses K-edge-aware interpolation for accurate cross-sections near absorption edges and integrates with Unitful.jl for dimensionally correct queries.
